function.name: run_ireg
function.description: Executes the integrated regression (ireg) process for a specified product. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

prod.description: The product code for which the ireg process should be executed. Valid product codes include 'fc' for Full Chip, 'starrc' for Star RC extraction, 'pt' for PrimeTime timing analysis, and 'nt' for NanoTime timing analysis.
